title: Ollie on the crypt bench, before his sheet comes back (ui/crypt-stage.js)
steps: picture: black-forest-labs/FLUX.1-schnell (Hugging Face Space, 4 steps): a seven year old boy asleep, curled on his side, grey hooded sweatshirt with the hood up, dark blue jeans, white socks, no shoes, on a plain grey ground
shape: tencent/Hunyuan3D-2 (Hugging Face Space, /shape_generation, 30 steps, octree 256, seed 1234) from that picture

colour and size: Blender 5.2, cut to 40000 faces; the picture's own camera found by laying his outline over the picture's (bearing -26, height 55, roll 30, overlap 0.87); each point that camera sees coloured from the picture, the rest from their nearest coloured points (vertex colour 'Col', the picture's sRGB values)
